added_places.name: Gnod Dam
added_places.clue: The great gnome dam at the south tip of the Inner Lake.  The gnomes dammed a river valley here, and the water climbed every creek to make the lake.  The Slanic river leaves from its spillway.
added_places.status: proposed, not one of the 100 gazetteer entries
